verdict.rationale: Evidence documents data-residency options (EU, AU, India endpoints) and data-privacy/opt-out controls (Model Improvement Program opt-out), which supports part of the compliance story. However there is no mention of HIPAA/BAA support or SOC 2 certification anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: HIPAA/BAA attestation documentation, SOC 2 report/certification evidence, and any explicit compliance framework page beyond data residency/privacy.
